field.subject: Identity-preserving field attention
field.purpose: Discover whether FIELD_ATTEND, DELINEATE, and LATCH form a coherent attention-local execution seam.

elements.content: Observer preserves subject continuity and accounts for every transition.
Field Attention proposes whole-field member patterns without declaring them true.
Delineation reconstructs explicit typed support while preserving every admitted identity.
Latch admits a supported pattern only to the current attention purpose after host gates pass.
Hard boundaries remain active during both receptive and explicit attention modes.
